note: Named athletes list only public facts. No win-loss records. Rates are never typed in here; they are inferred from UFC cohorts in archetypes.json.

disciplines.name: Kushti / Pehlwani
disciplines.blurb: Akhara wrestling. Throws and pins map onto UFC takedowns and top control. The rest of the card is what wrestler-first UFC fighters already do after a camp: hands, ground strikes, submissions.
disciplines.gap: No gloves, no fence, no chokes. Standing striking and submission hunting are camp skills, not kushti.

disciplines.name: Freestyle wrestling
disciplines.blurb: Olympic freestyle. Takedowns and takedown defence are the foundation. Boxing, ground-and-pound, and submissions come from the same wrestler-first UFC cohort.
disciplines.gap: A pin is not a choke. Freestyle does not train striking.

disciplines.name: Judo
disciplines.blurb: Throws and clinch. Mapped onto UFC fighters who actually take people down from the clinch. Hands and submissions on the card are those fighters' secondary tools.
disciplines.gap: The gi is gone. No-gi striking defence is inferred, not measured from Indian judo.

disciplines.name: Boxing
disciplines.blurb: Hands only. Standing volume and knockdowns come from striker-first UFC fighters. Their real takedowns and submissions fill the rest of the arsenal, the way a boxer who has learned to wrestle looks.
disciplines.gap: No kicks, no clinch throws, no ground game in the amateur record. Those rates are camp, not boxing.

disciplines.name: Kickboxing
disciplines.blurb: Hands and kicks. The full striker-first UFC card, including that cohort's wrestling and submissions.
disciplines.gap: Kickboxing does not train takedown defence the way MMA does. Wrestling on this card is inferred from UFC strikers, not from Indian kickboxing results.

disciplines.name: Kalaripayattu
disciplines.blurb: Empty-hand kalari. Striking is a shrunk step toward UFC strikers, because those years were not in gloves. Locks add a small submission step, still inside the striker-first range. Weapons stay outside the cage.
disciplines.gap: No UFC-comparable kalari bout log. The shrink is the admission that this mapping is inferred.

disciplines.name: Silambam
disciplines.blurb: The stick does not enter the octagon. What remains is distance and footwork, taken from range-first UFC fighters and then shrunk. Boxing, wrestling, and submissions on the card are that cohort's camp skills, not silambam.
disciplines.gap: A staff is not a jab. This card is expected to trail a typical UFC fighter until striking and wrestling are trained.
